sentence: This project studies how chimeric antigen receptors with activation motifs from jawless vertebrates send signals.
This project supports research on viruses such as influenza virus and herpesviruses.
This project works with communities to find out what keeps people from taking part in clinical trials, using machine learning.
This project builds modular chimeric synthetases that make it easier to change macrocyclic peptide drug candidates.
This project studies how macrophages, a type of immune cell, help cancer spread to the liver in mice with pancreas or colon cancer.
This project studies adipose stem cells and their niche in obesity.
This project studies how mitochondrial and peroxisomal dynamics affect metabolic signaling in brain development using patient-derived stem cells and brain organoids.
This project builds machine learning methods to estimate bone stiffness and predict strain in bone during dental implant surgery.
This project looks for biomarkers of portopulmonary hypertension, a cardiovascular disease that occurs in people with liver disease.
This project builds imaging methods using positron emission tomography and magnetic resonance imaging to measure brain energy in aging.
This project builds a mass spectrometry system with silicon microfluidic chips to study how biomolecules interact.
This project builds machine learning tools to find causal pathways behind differences in emergency department outcomes.
This project studies how chromatin remodeling helps parental chromosomes pair and separate properly in the germ line.
This project studies the pathways that control oncogene-induced senescence, a cellular brake that stops abnormal cells from becoming cancer.
This project supports HIV research, including clinical and behavioral studies, with the goal of ending the HIV epidemic.
This project uses cryo-electron microscopy to work out how rabies glycoprotein binds antibodies and cellular receptors.
This project builds computer models of brain aging to find early signs of Alzheimer's disease and related dementias and lifestyle factors that may affect them.
This project builds computer methods that use real-world data to suggest drugs that could be repurposed for Alzheimer's disease and related dementias.
This project tests gold nanoparticles that use CRISPR to put antibody genes against HIV into immune cells inside the body.
This project builds methods to monitor and update clinical decision support systems in real time so they stay accurate.
